params.name: product_id
params.description: Google Shopping product id -- returns a single product variant.

params.name: gpc_id
params.description: Google Product Cluster ID -- returns the full product cluster across all merchants.

params.name: location
params.description: Canonical geo location string (see the /api/v2/locations list endpoint).

params.name: search_engine
params.description: Google domain to query, e.g. google.com.

items.docs: This endpoint gives you access to shopping product pages by their product_id or gpc_id, which can be obtained from a shopping search. Pass product_id to get a single product variant, or gpc_id (Google Product Cluster ID) to get the full product cluster across all merchants.
